name: Mangal Electrical Industries Limited
summary: Mangal Electrical Industries Ltd. (MEIL) manufactures and trades electrical goods worldwide under the Mangal Electrical brand, including transformers and CRGO electrical steel. Its range covers transformer laminations, slit coils, cores, coil and core assemblies and oil-immersed circuit breakers. It also trades CRGO and CRNO coils and amorphous ribbons, and builds transformers from small single-phase units up to 10 MVA.
